audience: UK barbershops, salons and hair professionals that take bookings in Setora

useCases.title: See the locations and services
useCases.text: List the locations of the organisation. Then list the services, prices, durations and staff of one location.

useCases.title: Find open slots for a service
useCases.text: Get the bookable slots of a service at a location from a given date. Use them to answer a client question.

useCases.title: Find a client and a booking
useCases.text: Look up a client by phone or email. Open a booking by its reference to read the status, staff and times.

useCases.title: Book a client for a service
useCases.text: Create the client if needed. Pick a slot from the availability and create the booking.

useCases.title: Move a booking to a new slot
useCases.text: Find the booking, check the open slots, and reschedule it. The cancellation policy of the shop applies.

useCases.title: Cancel a booking
useCases.text: Open a booking and cancel it. The result shows if the deposit was refunded. You cannot undo a cancel.
